identifier_sources.gbif: api.gbif.org/v1/species/{key} (accepted usage looked up by key)
identifier_sources.ncbi: eutils esearch db=taxonomy + esummary (rank and name checked); NCBI name is 'Bos indicus' (species)
identifier_sources.wikidata: wbsearchentities + wbgetentities; item chosen whose P225 taxon name / P846 GBIF id matches
identifier_sources.itis: TSN from Wikidata P815, verified with ITIS getScientificNameFromTSN
identifier_sources.worms: no WoRMS statement on the Wikidata item

notes: GBIF treats Bos indicus Linnaeus, 1758 (usageKey 2441023) as a synonym of the accepted subspecies Bos taurus indicus (4262587); the accepted usage is recorded. NCBI ranks Bos indicus as a species (taxid 9915). Wikidata Q20908500 = Bos taurus indicus; Q20747726 = Bos indicus.
